title: Ambiguous Boolean Limit (Unprefixed Limit)
pattern: A limit constant or variable named `_limit` or `_threshold` without a prefix defining whether the boundary is inclusive, exclusive, or an upper/lower bound.
why_bad: An unprefixed limit name is ambiguous as to whether the limit is "up to" or "up to and including", leading to classic off-by-one errors when comparing values.
detection: Match numeric constants or variables containing the substring `_limit` or `_threshold` that lack `MAX_` or `MIN_` prefixes.
counterexample:
Explicit bounds using standard prefixes:
```rust
const MAX_ITEMS_IN_CART: u32 = 10;
```
source: *The Art of Readable Code* by Dustin Boswell and Trevor Foucher (Chapter 3, pp. 24-25).
